Strong interpersonal skills to guide employees through hardware and software challenges. Propose and implement design improvements for existing products, focusing on quality, cost reduction, and component obsolescence management. Strong understanding of digital circuit design principles, high-speed digital interfaces, and signal integrity. Proficiency with electronic design automation (EDA) tools for schematic capture, simulation (e.g., ModelSim/QuestaSim, Vivado Simulator), and FPGA development (e.g., Xilinx, Vivado). Proven ability to coordinate complex activities across multiple functional organizations. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and drive execution in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. Demonstrated history of taking initiative, solving operational challenges, and delivering results with minimal direction. Open, honest, and transparent communicator who builds trust and keeps stakeholders informed. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate issues and develop practical solutions. Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic manufacturing environment. Continuous improvement mindset with a desire to challenge existing processes and improve operational performance. Self-motivated professional with a strong desire to learn, grow, and advance within the organization.
